To streamline the pre-production phase, studios produce a design document for their product: a single source of truth for its creative direction. For a film or animation, this may take the form of a script and storyboards , depicting the contents, look, and feel of each scene. For a game, a game design document includes information about the story, gameplay, art direction, intended target audience and accessibility. The most important goal of pre-production is to iterate designs and introduce new ideas early, while changing direction is still relatively cheap and easy.
